stats._comment: 4.8 from 331 (data/google_reviews_top25.json) and 38 years (operating since 1988) are BOTH true and BOTH on the page — in the hero headline, the hero anchor and the reviews intro. They are null here on purpose: the quote template renders the counter bar inside a .dark section, but its CSS binds --fl-ink to the light-theme --fg and --fl-accent to the light-theme --btn at :root, so every label comes out #1C1F23 on a #22252A background (1.06:1) and every number comes out in the dark brand navy (1.46:1). Nothing in a client config can reach those variables. Rather than ship a half-invisible band, the bar is hidden and the numbers live in readable copy. Fix the template variables and put 4.8 / 331 / 38 straight back.

services.title: Split systems
services.blurb: One room or an open living area, with or without an inverter. Wall-mounted, floor-mounted or a ceiling cassette — Andrew or Anthea works out which suits the room, where the outdoor unit can legally sit and which of the six brands makes sense. Usually installed within a day.

services.title: Ducted systems
services.blurb: The indoor fan coil is suspended in the roof space on perforated straps, out of sight and away from the ceiling. A zone controller gives you four or eight zones, so you are not paying to cool empty rooms. Larger systems take two days.

services.title: Multi-split systems
services.blurb: Several rooms off a single outdoor unit, each head set and scheduled on its own. This is the answer when there is no room outside for three condensers and no way to run ducting through the roof space.

services.title: Service and repairs
services.blurb: We service any brand, even if it wasn't our installation — filters, gas, drains, controllers, the lot. Seniors get 10% off general servicing. That's the service itself, not parts or repairs. After-hours service is available.

reasons.title: You can walk in and look at it
reasons.body: There's a showroom in Russell Street, Emu Plains. Come in, talk through the options and ask whatever you like. Nobody will chase you out.

reasons.title: Andrew or Anthea quotes it
reasons.body: The two owners do the on-site sales and quotations themselves. Andrew is a qualified electrician and refrigeration technician, so the person pricing it is the person who knows what it takes.

reasons.title: Five years on the workmanship
reasons.body: Five years' workmanship warranty on domestic installations, twelve months on commercial, on top of the manufacturer's five-year parts and labour. It stays valid as long as we do the yearly general maintenance.

reasons.title: We'll fix a unit we didn't install
reasons.body: We service any brand, even if it wasn't our installation. Plenty of our service work started as somebody else's job.

reasons.title: Where it goes matters
reasons.body: Customers tell us we “problem solved the best way to install them in a way that was aesthetic to the house”. Pipe and wiring down an outside wall gets encased and colour-matched to your downpipe.

faq.q: Will you service a system you didn't install?
faq.a: Yes. We service any brand, even if it wasn't our installation. You get a written report on any service or repair, and if parts are needed we email you a written quote for your approval before we go ahead.

We're dealers for six major brands: Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, LG, Daikin, Actron Air and Braemar. Which one suits you depends on the room, the budget and what rebate the system attracts — come and see them in the showroom.

faq.q: How long does an installation take?
faq.a: As a guide, a wall-hung split system or a small ducted unit is usually in within a day. A larger ducted system can take two. Weather and the state of the roof space can move that, and we'll tell you at the quote, not afterwards.

On a domestic installation: five years' manufacturer warranty from the installation date covering parts and the associated labour, plus five years' workmanship warranty from us. Commercial is two years manufacturer and twelve months workmanship. The workmanship warranty stays valid as long as our technicians carry out the yearly general maintenance — we send you an Annual Maintenance Letter and the call-out is at a discounted rate. Flexible ducting carries a 20-year National Air Parts warranty against manufacturing defects.

The NSW Energy Savings Scheme gives homeowners a cash rebate on energy-efficient air conditioners, with no income threshold, and LMAC is an approved supplier for the scheme in the Penrith and Blue Mountains area. What comes back depends on the brand, the size of the system, whether it's new or a replacement, and your suburb's climate zone.

Strathdee Electrical Pty Ltd, Licence 127921C. Andrew and Anthea own that too — a family business handed down from Andrew's grandfather since 1956. It covers the electrical controls, the wiring between the indoor and outdoor units, and the sub-mains from the unit back to your switchboard.

faq.q: What pipe do you run, and will I see it?
faq.a: Refrigeration-grade copper that meets both the manufacturer's standard and Australian Standard AS1571, with the suction and liquid lines both insulated. Where pipe and wiring run down an outside wall they're encased in colour bonding, matched as close as we can to your existing downpipe or wall colour.

faq.q: Where does the outdoor unit go?
faq.a: On a poly slab beside the building, with about 100mm of breathing space behind it. Council rules and the Noise Pollution Act have a say in where it can sit, so we recommend the spot and the final call is yours. Reviewers say we “problem solved the best way to install them in a way that was aesthetic to the house”.

faq.q: What happens if the drain ever blocks?
faq.a: Condensate normally runs out through PVC into the roof gutter. We also fit a galvanised drip tray under the indoor fan coil that drains separately through the eaves. So if a drain ever blocks you see water at the eaves, usually near the front door, instead of through your ceiling. If you see that, ring us without delay.

faq.q: Can I come and see the units first?
faq.a: Please do. The showroom is at Unit 2/129 Russell St, Emu Plains, open Monday to Friday 8:30am to 4:30pm. Come in and ask whatever you like — that's what it's there for.

faq.q: Is there a discount for seniors?
faq.a: Yes — 10% off general servicing for seniors. It applies to the service itself, not to parts or repairs.

_source.aboutText: Lower Mountains Air Conditioning are experts in what we do – after all, we have been operating since 1988. The company originally opened in Blaxland East. Since that time, it's relocated to Smith Street, Emu Plains and then again to a larger premises in Russell Street, Emu Plains where we remain today. We do however, service a wide range of locations in Sydney such as Penrith and the Blue Mountains. We are proud to be dealers of six major brands: Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, LG, Daikin, Actron Air and Braemar. And service any brand, even if it wasn't our installation. Andrew and Anthea are the owners of Strathdee Electrical, a family-owned business now in its third generation, handed down from Andrew's grandfather since 1956. Andrew is a qualified electrician and experienced refrigeration, air conditioning and electrical technician. He has extensive experience in the field, installing and servicing domestic, industrial and commercial air conditioning, refrigeration equipment and electrical work. Andrew and Anthea are responsible for the general running of the business including on-site sales and quotations. In addition to this, they also participate in servicing and trouble-shooting any technical difficulties in most brands. They are supported by a reliable, loyal and qualified team of 14 staff including tradespeople, apprentices, trade assistants and friendly office staff. Please feel welcome to come visit our showroom to discuss options and ask any questions you may have. We are based in Emu Plains, proudly provide professional air conditioner installation and servicing across South Penrith, Blaxland, Springwood, Kingswood, Glenbrook, Cranebrook, Katoomba, Glenmore Park and the Blue Mountains.
